newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WP 220 ALL OUT, NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 95-2.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WP 220 ALL OUT, NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 95-2.

text.p: Northern Transvaal took a firm grip on their match with champions Western Province on the opening day of their SuperSport Series four-day match at Newlands on Friday.
They bowled out Province for a modest 220 with Rudi Bryson taking four for 64 and then knocked off 95 of the arrears for the loss of only two wickets.
But for an undefeated 81 by skipper John Commins it could have been much worse for Western Province.

He shared a vital fourth-wicket partnership of 79 with H.D. Ackerman (51) but the latter's dismissal heralded the loss of five wickets for 27 to leave Western Province deep in trouble at 145 for eight.
But partnerships of 39 and 36 with the Aubrey Martyn (17) and Brett Schultz (13) allowed Commins to steer his side to a respectable 220.

In the 30 overs remaining, Northerns made serious inroads with both openers batting enterprisingly before Martin van Jaarsveld mishooked after a breezy 27 and Andre Seymore was wastefully run out for 20.
